acs.text_first_line: AC1 The two intent operations are declared on the service base
AC2 The intent element set and the new row are fixed and the money stays the payment owner's
AC3 The decision-record element is declared and no event of this service is invented
AC4 The consumed shapes are declared with their call type and their owner
AC5 The fakes answer the owners and the drift test binds them
AC6 The nine contract tables, the naming baseline and the boundary are fixed
